By Test Type
Tensile Testing
Applies force to a material specimen in order to measure the material’s response to tensile (or pulling) stress
Compression Testing
Used to determine a material’s behavior under applied crushing loads
Bend and Flexural Testing
Measures the behavior of materials subjected to simple beam loading
Torsion Testing
Evaluates the properties of materials or devices while under stress from angular displacement
Dynamic and Fatigue Testing
Stresses a material within its elastic region with cyclic loads until the specimen fails due to fatigue
Impact Testing
Tests an object’s ability to resist high-rate loading
HDT and Vicat Tests
Determines the temperature at which a stressed sample undergoes deflection
Rheology Testing
Measures the deformation of matter under the influence of imposed stress
Peel Testing
Basic form of mechanical testing that measures the properties of an adhesive bond

 ASTM Standards
ASTM Standards
This section provides a curated overview of the most prominent and widely adopted ASTM standards relevant to the materials testing industry, offering professionals a reliable reference to support consistent practices, accurate results, and regulatory compliance across a wide range of applications. The standards included are selected based on their frequency of use, industry recognition, and relevance to core testing methods, ensuring that users are equipped with foundational guidelines for quality assurance and technical integrity. For solutions that are not mentioned within this section, please contact your local Instron office.
